paper.title_en: Inflation on the lattice: scalar Gauss-Bonnet single field inflation
paper.abstract_en: We use lattice methods to study inflation in the scalar Gauss-Bonnet (SGB) gravity theory. We focus on the ultra-slow-roll scenario with the peak frequency falls into the PTA band. In the parameter range we consider, we find that the lattice results exceed the perturbative predictions, which differs from the case in Einstein gravity. We further find that lattice corrections become significant when the peak of the primordial curvature spectrum reaches $\sim 10^{-2}$. We calculate the energy density spectra of second-order scalar induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) using the primordial power spectra obtained from both the lattice method and the traditional perturbative method, and analyze the SGB model in light of current pulsar timing array (PTA) observations. Our results indicate that lattice corrections enhance the ability of the SGB model to dominate the PTA observations.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文与脉冲星计时阵列(PTA)主题高度相关，使用格点方法研究标量Gauss-Bonnet引力中的暴胀及引力波谱，并为PTA观测提供可能解释。理论深度和原创性较高。
decision.title_zh: 在格点上的暴胀：标量Gauss-Bonnet单场暴胀
decision.abstract_zh: 我们使用格点方法研究标量Gauss-Bonnet (SGB)引力理论中的暴胀。我们专注于超慢滚动情形，其峰频落在PTA频带内。在我们所考虑的参数范围内，我们发现格点结果超过微扰预言，这与爱因斯坦引力中的情况不同。我们进一步发现，当原初曲率谱的峰值达到$\sim 10^{-2}$时，格点修正变得显著。我们使用从格点方法和传统微扰方法获得的原初功率谱，计算了二阶标量诱导引力波(SIGWs)的能量密度谱，并根据当前脉冲星计时阵列(PTA)观测分析了SGB模型。我们的结果表明，格点修正增强了SGB模型主导PTA观测的能力。
